title: Gemini 3 Flash Agent Hooks

steps.status: sanitized prompt streams to model contex

caption:
Your Gemini 3 Flash agent leaks state without hook validation.

Here's what actually happens inside a managed agent lifecycle:

1. USER REQUEST — The raw request payload sent by the user before any LLM execution begins.
2. PRE-CALL HOOK — Deterministic middleware that redacts sensitive PII, validates schema, and sets state.
3. GEMINI 3 FLASH — The model receives strictly sanitized context, preventing prompt injection leakage.
4. POST-CALL HOOK — An inspection barrier that checks requested tool signatures before execution.

When building production agents, hook architecture matters more than raw token throughput.

No magic — just explicit middleware pipelines around LLMs.
